title: ICM workspace
about: For a workspace laid out by the Interpretable Context Methodology: today, projects, wiki and upkeep.

sections.title: Today
sections.text: What needs you now. Add a button for each daily chore and a data tile for the count you check first.

sections.title: Projects
sections.text: Your active projects. A folders item lists the CONTEXT.md and handoff files in a project folder.

sections.title: Wiki and notes
sections.text: Notes you read often. Name the notes folder in settings notes_roots, then show it here.

sections.title: Upkeep
sections.text: Workspace chores such as audits, backups and syncs, each a button that runs a registry script.
